text:
sam: Heads-up: onboarding hit a weird failure when user homes are NFS-mounted. `redwoodctl login` errors out while trying to save profile.

sam: Error: 
```
error: could not save profile: failed to replace file atomically: rename /home/dev/.config/redwood/profiles.json.tmp -> /home/dev/.config/redwood/profiles.json: Invalid cross-device link

```

sam: Repro is easy: developer's $HOME is an NFS mount (CI uses shared home dir). The CLI uses atomic rename which fails across FS boundaries. Previously it fell back but now it exits with a hard error.

anya: Ugh. We've seen EXDEV on rename with NFS and Docker bind-mounts. Workarounds: set XDG_CONFIG_HOME to a local dir or run `redwoodctl login --profile-dir /tmp/rw` so it writes somewhere on the same FS.

dev-rel: For DX, two things would help: (1) detect EXDEV/EACCES and try a safe-write fallback (write-temp-in-same-dir then copy or write directly), (2) print a single-line remediation with sample command like `XDG_CONFIG_HOME=/tmp/redwood redwoodctl login --profile ci`.

sam: Also, the device code flow times out in some workshop setups. TTL=60s is too short when switching windows to paste code. When it times out the CLI returns a non-retryable exit. Need better guidance & retry.

nico: Agreed. Proposed flags: `--no-atomic` to disable atomic rename, `--profile-dir` to pick exact path, and `--device-ttl-seconds` to extend TTL. Also add auto-detect: if rename returns EXDEV, transparently switch to safe write and log a friendly note.

anya: Small repro attached in GH issue: mount /nfs/home into container and run `redwoodctl login`. Docker example: 
```
# run host with NFS mount at /nfs/home
docker run --rm -v /nfs/home/dev:/home/dev -e HOME=/home/dev redwood/redwoodctl:latest redwoodctl login --profile dev
```

ci-bot: (automated) job #212 failed: onboarding-nfs  error writing profile across FS. Logs: https://ci.internal/job/212

nico: I'll open a GH issue with repro and add a unit test that stubs os.Rename to return EXDEV and asserts we show the XDG suggestion. Quick patch: try rename, if EXDEV then fallback to copy+unlink and exit code 0 with a WARN-level message.

sam: Thanks. Short-term note for docs: add "NFS / network home" troubleshooting section and a one-liner for CI: `mkdir -p /tmp/rw && export XDG_CONFIG_HOME=/tmp/rw && redwoodctl login`.
